pkr.title: Fire brigade incidents – Central Bohemia
pkr.description: Paste the incidents page URL with your filter (district, alarm level) applied.

firebrno_region.title: Fire Brno – region
firebrno_region.description: Select a region available from the source.

firebrno.title: Fire Brno – district
firebrno.description: Select a district or the whole region. Weekly, current-month and current-year history are available; active incidents are checked over the past 30 days. Optionally enter at least two characters of a unit name; leave empty for all units.

firebrno_unit.title: Fire Brno – responding unit
firebrno_unit.description: Select one matching unit, or leave the selection empty for all units. Enter another search to refresh the results. The unit filter combines with the selected region and district.

error.invalid_page: The data source has an unexpected structure
error.unit_search_short: Enter at least two characters of the unit name
error.unit_not_found: No matching units; change the name or clear the search for all units
